items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Just he and I cause Mendell had a job was going to fly out and Tal was going to come out after Mendell

ctx.x: So, he wanted to do it. He wanted to go to California, he'd never been. He liked the idea of the trio. But he had to get out of his job, so I booked in Oshkosh-- now here's a strange story of getting the bass. I heard Red Mitchell over in Jersey, once, he was a young kid, and I thought he had great potential. So I thought of his name and I found out he was living in a certain hotel in New York. So I called there and asked for him. I -- A guy answers the phone, I said, 'Red,' he said, 'Yes.' I said, 'This is Red…

of -- by the side of the Park Central Hotel, and go. We'll go. Just he and I cause Mendell had a job was going to fly out and Tal was going to come out after Mendell -- Mendell was going to stay till Tal got through with his job with the Little Club.
